stem: One zone missed irrigation before shift end because a fault remained unresolved. What should the handoff say?
choices: Mark irrigation complete because the shift ended and the remaining fault has already been escalated.
Identify the missed zone, actual delivery status, checks completed, unresolved fault, escalation status, and next required action.
Leave the issue out of handoff until maintenance confirms the root cause.
Copy the planned completion status so the schedule remains consistent.
rationale: The next shift needs the actual operational state, not the planned one. A strong handoff identifies which zone missed irrigation, what checks were completed, what fault remains unresolved, who has been notified, and what must happen next. Waiting for a final diagnosis can create a continuity gap.
